Rangeland Resouces and Systems Research, Agicultural Research Service, USDA

record.site_desc: The CPER LTAR site encompassed a large portion of the Colorado Piedmont Section of the western Great Plains. The research site is located 61 km east of Fort Collins and 40 km northeast of Greeley in Weld County, Colorado.  The CPER is a contiguous 6280 ha block of land. Grazing studies begun in the 1930's are still being conducted to evaluate the long-term impacts of livestock on rangeland resources.  This tower is located in a pasture with traditional grazing management

grp_igbp.igbp_comment: semi arid grassland with blue grama (Bouteloua gracilis) the predominant species
